headline: Executive order creates a federal task force focused on fraud against consumers and on keeping financial markets honest.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new federal task force on market integrity and consumer fraud. Based on its title, the group's job is to coordinate the government's work against fraud that harms consumers and against wrongdoing that undermines fair markets. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and specific duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Consumers who are targets of scams or fraud
who_it_affects.how: Fraud that affects them would be a focus of the new federal task force.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals involved in financial markets
who_it_affects.how: Practices that hurt market fairness could draw more coordinated federal attention.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle fraud cases
who_it_affects.how: They may be asked to work together through the new task force.
